definitions: A Brazilian television network, launched in 1965 by Roberto Marinho. It is the largest commercial television network in South America and the second-largest commercial broadcaster in the world.
A major producer of telenovelas, news, and entertainment programming in Brazil.
examples: TV Globo is known for its extensive coverage of Brazilian culture.
Many Brazilians grew up watching TV Globo.
The new series premiered on TV Globo last night.
